name: seven
label: seven — seven.io Gateway API
description: seven via the official seven.io Gateway API. Base https://gateway.seven.io/api. Docs: https://docs.seven.io/en/. Formerly sms77. Local telecom rules apply. Official gateway.seven.io. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One seven operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-sms"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-sms | voice-call. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Recipient MSISDN for send-sms / voice-call. Required. Comma-separated for SMS. Example: +4915123456789.

schema.label: text
schema.description: SMS body (max 1520 chars) or TTS text for voice-call. Required.

schema.label: from
schema.description: Sender id (phone or alphanumeric ≤11). Falls back to config from.

schema.label: delay
schema.description: send-sms delay as unix timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-sms, voice-call. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: seven.io API key. Header X-Api-Key. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
